description: A consensus-developed framework defining 22 head and neck surgery competencies for general surgery residents and fellows, intended to guide curriculum development and training standardization.
title: A 22-competency framework for general surgery residents in head and neck surgery

description: A 25-competency framework and physician-ranking instrument for judging the relative importance of surgery and internal-medicine residents' competencies in entrustment decisions.
title: A 25-competency ranking framework for entrustment decisions in first year residents

description: An open-access nursing education package developed by Salami Oluwabukola et al.
title: A-CHARM project

description: A research dataset of 90 audio-recorded and speaker-diarized transcripts of Chinese-English code-switched group discussions by freshman engineering mathematics students in a flipped classroom, created by Hang Su et al.
title: A Chinese-English code-switched flipped classroom discussion audio corpus of 90 group discussions

description: A proposed multi-agent software workflow that transforms source problems into verified, isomorphic, LaTeX-formatted problem variants for introductory mechanics instruction.
title: A five-stage LLM agent workflow for isomorphic problem generation: Normalizer, Extractor, Verifier, Generator, and Latexifier

description: A National Research Council framework that defines science and engineering practices, crosscutting concepts, and disciplinary core ideas to guide K–12 science standards, curriculum, instruction, and assessment.
title: A Framework for K-12 Science Education: Practices, Crosscutting Concepts, and Core Ideas

description: A jointly developed evaluation-planning guide from the American Institutes for Research and Mathematica Policy Research to help state education agencies evaluate ARRA-funded initiatives and other educational reforms.
title: A guide for states on evaluating ARRA-funded programs and other educational reforms

description: A box-trainer simulator with a removable suturing sheet, made by Kyoto Kagaku Co., Ltd., for training and objectively assessing open or laparoscopic suturing skills.
title: A-LAP mini simulator

description: A computer-based Monte Carlo simulator developed by Caro Huertas et al.
title: A Monte Carlo stochastic simulator of student academic performance along a university curriculum

description: A nine-area map of the knowledge, skills, and attitudes required for psychosocial care in adult and older adult acute mental health inpatient settings, developed by Wood et al.
title: A nine-area psychosocial competency framework for acute mental health inpatient care

description: A nine-domain framework developed by Vanessa Cruz Molina et al.
title: A nine-competence framework for physics teaching in engineering education (C1–C9)

description: The A-OSATS score is an expert-consensus, 15-substep observational assessment instrument for rating minimally invasive linear-stapled, hand-sewn intestinal anastomosis performance in surgeons, residents, and medical students.
title: A-OSATS score

description: A + PAAC is a classroom programme developed by Donnelly and colleagues in which elementary teachers integrate moderate-to-vigorous physical activity into existing academic lessons, supported by teacher training and coaching.
title: A + PAAC

description: Tim Coughlan's framework organises open-data learning practice into six categories and 28 themes to help educators design and support activities involving open data.
title: A six-category, 28-theme conceptual framework of open data use in learning

description: A historical toolkit providing evidence-based writing-instruction guidance, tip sheets, and professional-development supports for grades 2–4 teachers and school leaders.
title: A Toolkit to Support Evidence-Based Writing Instruction in Grades 2 Through 4 (Historical)

description: A twelve-item yes/no checklist developed for medical educators and item writers to detect technical item-writing flaws in AI-generated multiple-choice questions.
title: A twelve-item checklist for reviewing AI-generated MCQs, adapted from the NBME item-writing guide

description: An open-access PhysioNet dataset of Empatica E4 physiological signals collected from college students during exams, released for studying stress and predicting cognitive performance.
title: A Wearable Exam Stress Dataset for Predicting Cognitive Performance in Real-World Settings
